bugShape.problem: lock-sensitive journal_mode executes before the intended busy handler is installed

reproducer.precondition: another SQLite connection holds BEGIN EXCLUSIVE on the same file when NewSQLiteRepository starts
reproducer.red: buggy constructor returns SQLITE_BUSY before lock release
reproducer.green: fixed constructor waits within the existing 5000ms budget and succeeds after release

validControls: fixed constructor reads back journal_mode=wal, busy_timeout=5000, foreign_keys=1 and preserved data

mutationVariants.change: move PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL before PRAGMA busy_timeout = 5000 in the fixed source
mutationVariants.expected: held-lock regression fails for AG03_STARTUP_BUSY_BEFORE_RELEASE / SQLITE_BUSY

whyPreviouslyMissed: existing ordinary startup coverage did not force a real external lock before the first lock-sensitive pragma; the configured busy timeout existed but was installed too late
applicableScope: SQLite initialization sequences where a busy timeout is intended to cover earlier lock-sensitive startup operations
consumer-owned startup code with a deterministic external-lock reproducer
nonApplicableScope: arbitrary SQL pragma ordering without a proven lock-sensitive precondition
transaction semantics, schema changes, retry policy or Yunka Executor/UoW behavior
other database drivers without equivalent demonstrated semantics
